Georgetown

Georgetown

Brewery  |  Taproom  | Beer Garden


Our Taproom and Beer Garden in Georgetown are kiddo and dog friendly. Outside food is welcome! And we do offer light snacks, including charcuterie snackpacks, all-beef hotdogs & in-house smoked kielbasa sausages. Wine, hard cider, hard seltzer and plenty of non-alcoholic options are available too.


And we specialize in group reservations!

Green LakE

Green Lake

Taproom | Kitchen | Patio


Our Taproom and Kitchen is located across the street from one of Seattle's gems, Green Lake.


In addition to our award winning beer, we offer a charcuterie inspired menu featuring fresh salads, deli-style sandwiches, pub comforts and sweet treats.


If beer isn't your bag, we still love you! We offer wine, hard cider, locally sourced spirits, and plenty of non-alcoholic options.


Kiddos are always welcome! Pups on the patio. And large communal tables for groups. Come hang with us!


Green Lake Reservations

Green lake menus

GREEN LAKE - Reservations

Our Green Lake location is ideal for groups large and small. We love to host teams and families. Please note, we only take reservations Mon-Thurs on a limited basis.


For groups of 40 or less, with a minimum of 8, we can set you up in the taproom with a section of communal tables. And if you've got a bigger shindig planned, ask us about a buyout of the whole joint. 


Green Lake has a kitchen. We require all food to be ordered from us. For big groups, we can cater too.
